Can I use the videos for commercial ads?
Yes. All videos generated using Seedance 2.0 on Lovart come with full commercial rights, making them perfect for TikTok, Facebook Ads, and websites.
Text-to-Video or Image-to-Video: Which is better?
Text-to-Video is best for creating entirely new scenes. Image-to-Video (I2V) is ideal when you need strict control over the composition and character identity.
